items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Harvey Langford and his father's band, but the interviewee (Zutty Singleton) does not respond or provide any personal anecdote or connection to Harvey Langford in the provided text.

ctx.x: That was a must in St. Louis then, you understand what I mean, you had to read, you know, because Old Man Langford, Harvey Langford's father, he was a great trombone player too. He was in the circus too, but Old Man Langford had a band under one of the largest, the Masonics.
